thread:
marta: Sales flagged a customer ask: 12mo reserved embedding commit with per-route QPS + monthly burst bucket. Can we scope a tight MVP?
john: short answer: yes if we limit to embeddings + quantized model family. Need infra, billing, legal.
sylvie: MVP product proposal: Route Reserve SKU, per-route QPS field in console, burst pool cap, fallback to best-effort route when exhausted. No gen/chat.
frank: infra quick note: implement soft reservations + per-tenant token bucket. estimate ~2 infra sprints + 1 for monitoring. Need policy for preemption.
kayla: legal: avoid hard "guarantee" wording. recommend "commercially reasonable efforts" and a credit cap. also include cancellation notice (30d) and force majeure carveout.
marta: launch checklist idea: 1) billing SKU & pricing band 2) console/API controls 3) routing + fallback 4) runbook + canary plan 5) legal sign-off.
john: sales wants three tiers to present: Starter (no reserve), Reserve (reserved qps, no SLA), Enterprise (reserved qps + burst + SLA/support). Can someone propose numbers?
frank: back-of-envelope: 20 qps embeddings ~= $12k/mo infra delta; Enterprise add ~2x for SLA/support buffer. will finalize spreadsheet.
sylvie: negotiation levers: cap monthly burst (e.g., 1M tokens), automatic fallback, cap credits. propose pilot with 5 tenants.
marta: owners: sylvie (spec), frank (infra), john (sales liaison), kayla (legal). I'll schedule a short sync Friday 9am PT.
legal-bot: created ticket PRD-9001: Route Reserve MVP (assignee: sylvie)
all: ack :)
